mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and retail sales signals broad-based consumer demand weakness, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 1.0% year-over-year signals supply chain improvements boosting corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 101.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO > 101.0 is below 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts trend indicates improving consumer confidence and demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 2.0% for two consecutive months signals monetary tightening increasing equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% for 2 months, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth and rising unemployment rate signals labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 230 signals high inflation triggering central bank tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230, or Rank IC for CPIAUCSL > 230 is below 0.02 over 2-year rolling window.
